# netbox_device_bay_attachment (Resource)

Installs a device into an existing device bay. This resource is useful when device bays are created automatically by other resource and you want to attach a device to the bay.

**Note:** This resource only manages the installation/attachment of a device to a bay. It does not create or delete the bay itself. Use `netbox_device_bay` to create and manage bays.

**Import:** This resource can be imported using the composite ID format `device_id:bay_name` (e.g., `123:BAY1`). For backward compatibility, importing with just the bay ID is also supported, but the ID will be converted to the composite format.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bay_name` (String) Name of the device bay. The bay must already exist on the parent device.
- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device that contains the bay. Parent device of the bay.
- `installed_device_id` (Number) ID of the device to install into the bay. Child device of the bay.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
